environments.name: CI
environments.purpose: contract, fixture, app, compose, generated-client, image-build, and scan validation
environments.entrypoint: ops/ci/stage0-rev2-ci.yml draft; install under .github/workflows only with workflow-scoped token
environments.release_control: pull request and main checks after workflow installation

environments.name: staging
environments.purpose: private beta rehearsal with production-like dependencies
environments.entrypoint: SHA-tagged CI image promotion after CI gate

environments.name: production
environments.purpose: invite/comp-only or public launch after do-not-launch gate passes
environments.entrypoint: approved release tag using SHA-tagged images

ci_draft.not_installed_reason: current automation token lacks workflow scope; do not create .github/workflows from this lane

feature_flags.name: OTEL_ENABLED
feature_flags.rollback_use: disable trace export if collector causes instability

scripts/load_smoke.sh supports modes, but runtime pass evidence requires running compose services

ops/evidence/stage0_observability_evidence.json defines signals and SLOs; ops/evidence/staging/20260527T1830Z-observability-runtime.json validates staging observability while staging restore/load/post-deploy and production release observability evidence remain open
